_comment: THE THREE-AXIS TEMPLATE CONTRACT.
This file is the single written-down copy of a fact that lives in three
places that cannot import each other:
invitation/js/registry.js            the web renderer  (this repository)
src/features/digitalInvitations/registry.ts   the mobile editor
digital_invitations_template_known   the database CHECK constraint
Each of the three tests itself against THIS file rather than against the
other two. That is the whole mechanism: there is no runtime synchronization,
no network call and no generated code — just three suites failing loudly the
moment one list moves without the others.
WHY A FILE AND NOT A SHARED MODULE: the mobile app is a different repository
with a different toolchain, and the database has neither. A checked-in JSON
document is the only artefact all three can read. It is duplicated ON PURPOSE
and the duplication is what the tests pin.
ORDER IS SIGNIFICANT. It is the order the mobile picker draws, and the tests
compare sequences, not sets — so a reshuffle is a deliberate edit here.
ADDING A DESIGN: web renderer first (it must be drawable and deployed), then
this file, then mobile, then the database. Each step only widens what the
previous one already handles, so there is never a window where an organizer
can author something that cannot be drawn or cannot be stored.
